details.description: we were testing lines making sure there were no leaks on our lines, saw a 4in house had a puncture and was leaking out water, told the driller to stop pumping so we can fix the problem
Water hauler came in location flying no lights on
While my crew and I were hammering hoses, I noticed the top of the sledge hammer slowly sliding off as we kept hitting it more and more
After we skid the mud line was leaking so we let the driller now we can stop and we tight it back up
Fms hoses connected to the control box was big trip hazard on the rig.

details.description: Using forklift to rig down tools from rig floor and noticed cementer was in the buffer zone of a suspended load

Matthew stepped up in casing pre task briefing and discussed the LSRA very thoroughly
